description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks for the JSON:API module, including help text, module installation checks, entity bundle creation/deletion, entity creation/deletion, and access control for various entity types within the JSON:API context.

classes.name: JsonapiHooks
classes.description: Implements Drupal hooks for the JSON:API module, providing help text, module installation warnings, entity creation/deletion handling, and access control for various entity types.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information about the JSON:API module when the help route is accessed.

methods.name: modulesInstalled
methods.description: Checks for conflicting modules upon installation and issues warnings if necessary.

methods.name: entityBundleCreate
methods.description: Rebuilds routes when an entity bundle is created.

methods.name: entityBundleDelete
methods.description: Rebuilds routes when an entity bundle is deleted.

methods.name: entityCreate
methods.description: Rebuilds routes when certain entity types are created.

methods.name: entityDelete
methods.description: Rebuilds routes when certain entity types are deleted.

methods.name: jsonapiEntityFilterAccess
methods.description: Determines access permissions for core entity types based on admin permissions.

methods.name: jsonapiBlockContentFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for block content entities.

methods.name: jsonapiCommentFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for comment entities.

methods.name: jsonapiEntityTestFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for test entities.

methods.name: jsonapiFileFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for file entities.

methods.name: jsonapiMediaFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for media entities.

methods.name: jsonapiNodeFilterAccess
methods.description: Determines access permissions for node entities, considering permissions like 'bypass node access' and 'access content'.

methods.name: jsonapiShortcutFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for shortcut entities.

methods.name: jsonapiTaxonomyTermFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for taxonomy term entities.

methods.name: jsonapiUserFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for user entities.

methods.name: jsonapiWorkspaceFilterAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for workspace entities.
